subject: PO normalization & billing rhythm — request for carveout on net terms
messages:
From: Sarah Low <sarah.low@novacorp.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com
Date: 2026-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO normalization & billing rhythm — Redwood proposal

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — Novacorp is excited about the latency and cost numbers. Procurement ran the proposed commercial worksheets past our AP team and we have a couple of non-negotiable constraints on our side that we need you to confirm can be supported before we take this to legal: 

- Our ERP requires a normalized PO identifier that maps to our parent/legal entity and child BU (we often need three PO fields to reconcile invoices across ledgers). Can Redwood map multiple incoming PO headers to a single Redwood billing account?
- We run a biweekly cut for AP (every other Friday). For vendor-side invoicing we need invoices to match that cadence — we can accept consolidated monthly statements internally but the invoice file produced by Redwood must be on the biweekly schedule.
- Standard payment is Net45. We understand your standard is Net30; will you accept Net45 for Novacorp (public company, credit-verified)?

One more commercial note: discounts at our company are tied to invoice cadence/commitment length. If we keep biweekly invoices we typically require deeper discounts than monthly billing. Would Redwood be open to an 8% list discount in exchange for an 18-month commitment and ability to accept our PO mapping?

I attached our PO spec for reference. Can you confirm technical and commercial viability (and any caveats) by EOD Thursday?

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Low
Sr. Procurement Manager, Novacorp
procurement@novacorp.com
Attachment: PO-spec.pdf
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Low <sarah.low@novacorp.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO normalization & billing rhythm — Redwood proposal

Hi Sarah — really appreciate the clear constraints and the spec. Quick answers and a pragmatic option set: 

1) PO mapping: yes — we can ingest up to three PO header fields and persist them on invoice line metadata so you can reconcile by BU. We will need a sample file to validate field names/lengths.

2) Biweekly invoices: technically doable. Our hosted billing system prefers monthly statements (cost reasons) but we can emit biweekly invoice files to your AP. Two caveats: we currently apply our default pricing discounts to monthly consolidated usage. Keeping biweekly invoices without consolidation would reduce discounting efficiency.

3) Net terms: Net45 is possible but requires sign-off from Finance for enterprise customers. Typically Finance asks for either a small onboarding credit holdback or a slightly higher unit price to offset receivable risk.

Commercially, a couple of proposals to bridge the gap quickly: 
- Option A (preferred for Novacorp reliability): Accept biweekly invoice files + monthly consolidated statement. Net35 (compromise) with a one-time onboarding credit of $20k. 6% list discount for an 18-month committed volume (instead of the 8% you requested).
- Option B (finance-neutral): Full Net45, but +0.5% per-invoice processing surcharge on biweekly invoices. 8% discount for 18 months if you accept monthly consolidation (i.e., invoices issued monthly).

If you can share a sample PO extract (CSV) I’ll drop Ben from Sales Ops and Vanessa from Finance into the next note to draft a binding term sheet. I attached a sample invoice CSV to show the fields we would emit.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Attachment: sample-invoice.csv
From: Sarah Low <sarah.low@novacorp.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com
Date: 2026-05-29T15:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO normalization & billing rhythm — Redwood proposal

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick reply. A few clarifications from AP: 

- We cannot accept a processing surcharge — the cadence is a hard requirement tied to our treasury forecasting.
- We would consider Net35 only if there is an automated remittance/aging dashboard that both parties can access; otherwise the legal team will push for Net45.
- On discounts: Novacorp is open to 6% for 18 months if you can guarantee that biweekly invoice files are identical in format and naming each cycle (reduces ERP reconciliation effort).

We are prepared to sign an 18-month commitment at 6% if Redwood will: (1) support the PO mapping template (attached), (2) emit biweekly invoices with consistent file headers, and (3) accept Net45 with the requirement that Redwood provides a shared remittance dashboard (read-only) for our AP and Treasury.

Attached our procurement guidelines + example exports. Please confirm if Redwood can deliver all three items. If so, I’ll instruct Legal to start a draft SOW.

Best,
Sarah
Attachment: procurement-guidelines.docx
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-30T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Novacorp PO mapping & cadence — recommended concession

Team — looping you in to draft a final approach. Novacorp holds firm on biweekly invoices and Net45, and will accept 6% for 18 months if we: 

- Support their PO mapping template exactly (3 header fields). I attached their template in the thread.
- Emit biweekly invoice files with consistent headers/naming per their ERP ingest.
- Provide a read-only remittance dashboard (per-account aging view) for Novacorp AP/Treasury.

Trade-offs: Finance will want assurance on DSO exposure. My recommendation: accept Net45 + 18-mo 6% discount, but tie the discount eligibility to delivery of a monthly consolidated statement (audit/usage reconciliation) and cap DSO exposure by a $250k rolling receivable holdback that we can release after 60 days of on-time payments. Offer $20k onboarding credit (to cover integration/dev work).

Priyom — can Legal draft an SOW with a receivable holdback clause and an SLA for invoice file format? Vanessa — can Finance model incremental DSO exposure and confirm the $250k cap? Ben — if we get agreement, I’ll send the customer the term sheet and PO mapping template.

—Karthik
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Low <sarah.low@novacorp.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-31T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO normalization & billing rhythm — Redwood proposal

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear constraints and the example exports — we can support Novacorp’s requirements. Confirming the binding points so Legal can start the SOW: 

1) PO mapping: Redwood will ingest the three PO header fields exactly as in your template and persist them on invoice line metadata. We will deliver a sample mapping file within 3 business days for your validation (attached: po-mapping-template.csv).

2) Invoice cadence: Redwood will emit biweekly invoice files that match your requested filename/field schema. In addition we will provide a consolidated monthly statement for your internal accounting and discount reconciliation.

3) Terms and discount: Redwood will accept Net45 for Novacorp. Discounting: 6% off list for an 18-month committed volume (to be defined in the SOW). Discount eligibility is subject to monthly consolidation reconciliation (i.e., we will reconcile usage monthly and apply the discount on the consolidated invoice).

4) DSO protection: Redwood Finance requests a $250k rolling receivable cap (released as payments clear). We will also apply a one-time $20k onboarding credit to the first consolidated statement to cover integration work.

5) Visibility: We will provide a read-only remittance/aging dashboard (SLA: provisioned within 10 business days of contract signature).

If that aligns, I’ll ask Legal to prepare an SOW and Ben will send a commercial term sheet for countersignature. Please confirm and we’ll kick off legal.

Best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Attachments: po-mapping-template.csv
